Validate scene transforms and instance relationships separately for each game.

nativeGeometry.schema: SCNE vehicle declaration and draw-metadata versions 3/4

nativeGeometry.topology: UInt16 triangle strips, FFFF restarts; primary LOD selected from metadata; all LOD spans must partition the source index stream
nativeGeometry.positionScale: One integer quantizer constrained by all six scene extrema; reject inconsistent or ambiguous bounds
